pages.text: Food here touches seasons, Create machines, pollution and thirst. These are the links worth knowing before you build a big farm.
$(bold)Seasons decide what grows.$() Most crops only grow in some seasons. Greenhouses and underground farms get around it.$(br2)$(l:survival/seasons_crops)Crops by Season$(/l).

$(bold)Create farms and cooks.$() Harvesters and ploughs on contraptions reap fields, Slice & Dice's Sprinkler spreads Liquid Fertilizer, and Central Kitchen lets arms and deployers run Farmer's Delight pots and boards.$(br2)$(l:food/kitchen_automation)Kitchen Automation$(/l).
$(bold)Smog hurts crops.$() Heavy pollution stunts growth and kills grass and flowers. Keep burners away from fields, or put scrubbers between them.$(br2)$(l:survival/pollution)Pollution$(/l).

$(bold)Water for drinking$() can come from Create too: a pumped Sand Filter purifies it, and compacting cactus gives clean water.$(br2)$(bold)Bees$() link in through Enchantment Industry's super experience.$(br2)$(l:survival/thirst)Thirst$(/l), $(l:food/bees)Bees$(/l).
